svg.title: How a case works in Agent File
svg.desc: How a case works: 1. New case at midnight: Claude writes a fresh investigation every 24 hours: a story, suspects and evidence to follow.; 2. Work the missions: Crime scenes, agent files, wiretaps, witness depositions and coded messages like Morse.; 3. Close the file: Get a case report with your accuracy, mistakes, hints used and the XP you earned.; 4. Rise through the ranks: XP, streaks and medals move you from Special Agent toward Supervisory Special Agent. While a mission runs, a Live Activity keeps it on the lock screen.
